context: Read the selector and retained Actions evidence for each lane. Record collected-selection fingerprints and attributable runner-minutes where durably available; otherwise record explicit nulls and classify overlap as unknown. Do not change markers or workflows.
description:
Third item in the CI-waste sequence. Measure how much CI time is the identical fast-marker selection repeated across pull_request, merge_group, develop-post-merge, and nightly, including nightly OS/Python cells.

Classify identical selection, platform/version repetition, and unique work by runner-minute using the remesure snapshot. The predicted hit is nightly's multi-cell identical fast suite versus PR and post-merge make ci-test.

This item produces an inventory. It does not skip, shard, or demote any lane.

anti_patterns.dont: confuse collected parametrized case count with novelty
anti_patterns.instead: fingerprint selection and weight by minutes
anti_patterns.why: 28k is collect count, not unique properties

anti_patterns.dont: treat overlap as authorization to skip a required lane
anti_patterns.instead: report identical vs unique runner-minutes only
anti_patterns.why: skip/split is a later decision gate after this inventory

preserves.behavior: Fast-lane count ceiling and delta guard remain
No marker demotion or workflow skip in this item

prior_art.concept: OS/Python matrix of the same fast marker
